title: StarCraft Notification
blurb: Two tenths of a second of clean digital blip, and thousands of people have set it as their message tone. Blizzard's StarCraft games are full of these short alerts, built to cut through a battle without stealing attention from it, and that discipline is why the sound ages so well beside modern notification chimes. It sounds like competence. Put it on a phone and every incoming text starts to feel like a build order update rather than an interruption from somebody who wants something from you.
origin: A notification blip from Blizzard's StarCraft.
